description: .tekton/ is synthesized from self-ci.ts, so an image or @tektonic-ci/core bump changes it. This re-synthesizes on the branch so the PR carries both sides; fileFilters commits nothing when the output is unchanged.
Needs the self-hosted Renovate's allowedCommands to admit '^npm ci' and '^npm run synth', or the tasks are skipped silently. check-manifests in self-CI stays the backstop.

customManagers.description: Image pins: self-ci.ts (which .tekton/ is generated from) and DEFAULT_GCS_CACHE_IMAGE in src/gcs-backend.ts.

packageRules.description: Generated manifests are output, not source: the ansible manager would otherwise match .tekton/tasks/*.yaml.
The peer range on core is a compatibility promise, widened deliberately in a release of its own (ADR 0002), not bumped by a bot.
